steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.state.settings.autoQuality=false; g.setQuality('high'); g.dpr=1; g.renderer.setPixelRatio(1); g.resize(); g.bears.directorT=9999; const we=g.env.weather; we.cloud=0.3; we.cloudTarget=0.3; we.rain=0; we.rainTarget=0; we.timer=9999; g.hud.firstShown=-1000; g.hud.hint('',0); g.hud.show(false); __rhf.god(true); g.env.timeScale=0; g.player.tool='none'; g.viewmodel.setTool('none'); g.wildlife.threatPos=()=>({x:1e7,z:1e7,loud:0}); window.__faceSun=async(place,hour,pitch,label)=>{ const p=g.world.place(place); g.env.setTime(hour); g.player.place(p.x,p.z,0); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); g.env.setTime(hour); const s=g.env.sunDir; g.player.yaw=Math.atan2(-s.x,-s.z)+0.12; g.player.pitch=pitch; g.player.tool='none'; g.viewmodel.setTool('none'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,5000)); return label+': sun '+g.env.sunElevation.toFixed(1)+' deg, rays '+g.sunRays().toFixed(2)+', post '+g.post.enabled+', hdr '+g.post.hdr; }; return 'post ready, hdr '+g.post.hdr})()
(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.post.enabled=false; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,3000)); return 'post off'})()
(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.post.enabled=true; return await __faceSun('falls',19.8,0.12,'evening sun through the forest')})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const p=g.world.place('glacier'); g.env.setTime(13); g.player.place(p.x,p.z,p.face||0); g.player.pitch=0.12; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,5000)); return 'snow at noon'})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.post.enabled=true; const ia=g.props.interactions.find(i=>i.id==='post'); const L=g.props.nightLights[1]; g.env.setTime(0.5); const dx=L.x-ia.x, dz=L.z-ia.z; const x=ia.x-dx*3, z=ia.z-dz*3; g.player.place(x,z,Math.atan2(-(L.x-x),-(L.z-z))); g.player.pitch=0.05; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000)); g.env.setTime(0.5); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,4000)); return 'night at the Trading Post'})()
